chapter_title_en: The Cry of the Nine Provinces
chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Chapter 371: The Cry of Humanity in Chang'an Under the Hundred Races
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen, as a Yellow Diamond skeleton, enters Chang'an and witnesses the oppression of humans by the Hundred Races. He secretly aids a defiant drunk, revealing his soul power.
og_title: World of Immortality Ch. 371: The Cry of Humanity
og_description: Xiao Chen, disguised as a skeleton, witnesses the plight of humans in Chang'an as the Hundred Races dominate. He uses the 'Weng' sound to protect a human critic without revealing himself.
twitter_description: In Chang'an, Xiao Chen hears the despair of humans under the Hundred Races. He discreetly saves a man from execution using his Death World powers.
